title: Content
deleteConfirmMessage: Only a never-published draft can be deleted.
publishConfirmMessage: The material will become available to users.
unpublishConfirmMessage: The material will disappear from the catalog for users.
validationHttpUrl: Enter a full URL like https://example.com
validationUnit: Fill at least one unit field
name: Title
nameHelp: Short name users will see in the catalog.
descriptionHelp: Longer copy about the material. You can format it in the editor.
kindHelp: Kind changes required fields: book, podcast, and video need a URL and a cover.
languageHelp: Language the material is published in.
tagsHelp: Keywords for search. Add one at a time, up to 10 tags and 30 characters each.
coverMediaIdHelp: Copy the cover file ID from the Media section and paste it here.
urlHelp: Public http(s) link to the book, podcast episode, or video.
unitTitleHelp: Title of this part (chapter, episode, block).
unitBodyHelp: Main text for this part. You can format it in the editor.
unitUrlHelp: Optional. Full http(s) link only; leave empty otherwise.
deleteUnitMessage: The unit will be removed and the rest renumbered.
